scope.panel: Fixed 80 OPV2V frames across 16 scenes, exploratory screen.
scope.condition: 256 KiB, 100 Mbps shared uplink, RTT 10 ms, 35/50 ms cutoffs.
scope.wall_clock: One nonpreemptive worker uses the median of three synchronized measured receiver wall times for each exact packet state. The clock combines frozen modeled packet arrivals with cached receiver inputs and isolated serial computation. Local fallback is already ready.
scope.first_detection: First completed nonempty cooperative snapshot by cutoff, or original local fallback. Every frozen frame remains in pooled AP.
scope.final_detection: Newest completed snapshot by cutoff, or original local fallback. Complete detection means the full semantic state finished.
scope.work: Cumulative CPU is measured CPU postprocess wall. Cumulative GPU is measured traced CUDA fusion+heads span. Separate components for completed jobs only. Busy wall also includes partial work from an in-flight job at the cutoff. Components must not be added to estimate whole receiver service.
